plan.summary: PR-3b-1 (cxapi delivery-correlation foundation): capture the WhatsApp wamid that cxapi /api/chatoperation returns in the response 'data' field and persist it as outbound_messages.external_message_id at send time, plus a partial composite-UNIQUE (tenant_id, external_message_id) index — so a later ack (whose InstanceMessageID == that wamid) can be matched tenant-scoped. Inert/no-op until the gate opens.
plan.q_intent: cevaplar geldi — INMA confirmed C1 (send response data = wamid = ack InstanceMessageID) + C2 (ack reaches our WebhookUrl) + InstanceID globally-unique; devam (proceed to PR-3b). Split agreed: 3b-1 = send-side wamid capture + ext_id unique (dependency-free foundation); 3b-2 = ack ingress endpoint.
plan.interview_notes: Design decided 2026-06-08 via AskUserQuestion: (1) ack ingress = CustomHeader per-tenant token (auth + tenant identity), dedicated Backend endpoint, shape-discriminate, wamid+InstanceID cross-check -> PR-3b-2. (2) inbound-on-same-URL = robust forward + parallel INMA clarification -> PR-3b-2. THIS plan (3b-1) is the dependency-free foundation only. Correlation key per INMA C1 is the response 'data' field (a STRING wamid), NOT requestID; our send client currently deserializes env.Data but never reads it. external_message_id is presently NULL on every row (sole writer passes null), so the partial unique index builds against an empty set. FindMessageByExternalIdAsync stays tenant-blind in 3b-1 (its only caller is the bridge-format delivery-status endpoint which has no tenant_id); it becomes tenant-scoped atomically with the new tenant-aware ack endpoint in 3b-2. Gate (P0-3) stays CLOSED: no tenant allowlisted, so no cxapi row is ever created and this PR is a byte-for-byte runtime no-op.

verification_questions.question: Does the wamid capture read env.Data defensively so a cxapi response whose 'data' is null, empty, or a non-string JSON shape (object/array/number) never throws and simply yields ProviderMessageId=null instead of corrupting external_message_id?

Is external_message_id written ONLY on a genuinely Submitted (provider-accepted) send, so that ProviderFailed/RateLimited/Ambiguous/TransportError outcomes never persist a wamid (which would create an unmatchable or misleading correlation row)?

Is the partial composite UNIQUE (tenant_id, external_message_id) safe to deploy given external_message_id is currently NULL on every existing row (so the index builds against zero non-null rows), and does the migration stay idempotent + fail-loud on re-run?

Does this PR keep the P0-3 live-enablement gate intact (no tenant allowlist change, no FindMessageByExternalIdAsync tenant-scoping yet, no ack endpoint), so it remains a runtime no-op until PR-3b-2 + tenant WapCRM config land?

forbidden_areas: CxapiSendOptions.cs / appsettings CxapiSend allowlist (gate MUST stay closed)
src/Invekto.Outbound/Program.cs delivery-status endpoint (bridge format — untouched until 3b-2)
FindMessageByExternalIdAsync tenant-scoping (atomic with the 3b-2 ack endpoint that supplies tenant_id)
Backend webhook/event ingress + any new ack endpoint (PR-3b-2)
non_goals: Ack/delivery-status ingestion of the WapCRM SubscribedWebhook shape
Lifting the P0-3 gate or allowlisting any tenant
intentional_exclusions: No status-downgrade guard or idempotency here (no ack path in 3b-1)
No tenant-scoped lookup change (kept tenant-blind; bridge caller unchanged)
No new error codes (ProviderMessageId capture is on the existing Submitted path)

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: A non-string/empty 'data' yields ProviderMessageId=null BY DESIGN (defensive) — this is an intentional soft path, not a silent failure, because in 3b-1 the column is unused at runtime (no ack lookup, gate closed). If INMA ever returns a non-string data for a Submitted send, the send still succeeds and is logged via existing provider_* fields; the only effect is a null external_message_id, which 3b-2 will surface (an ack with no matchable row is logged, never mis-attributed). No exception path is introduced.

aha_moments.user_pain: Bulk WhatsApp sends via cxapi today have no per-message delivery truth — the operator cannot tell delivered from read from failed.
aha_moments.suggestion: Capturing the wamid at send time is the keystone that later lets each recipient row show sent/delivered/read/failed.
aha_moments.aha_moment: The operator opens a broadcast and sees real per-recipient delivery states instead of a single 'sent' blob.

aha_moments.user_pain: When a customer says 'I never got the message', support has no provider-side evidence to check.
aha_moments.suggestion: The stored wamid links our row to the WhatsApp provider id, so a failed/NotSent ack with ReasonDetailForNotSent becomes traceable.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Support pastes the customer's number and immediately sees 'failed (131026)' with the provider reason.

aha_moments.user_pain: Cross-tenant delivery mis-attribution is the exact risk that froze cxapi go-live.
aha_moments.suggestion: The (tenant_id, external_message_id) unique index guarantees a wamid resolves to exactly one tenant's message.
aha_moments.aha_moment: The team can finally open the gate knowing an ack can never write to the wrong tenant.

aha_moments.user_pain: Re-enabling delivery tracking later would mean a risky retrofit if the correlation key were missing.
aha_moments.suggestion: Storing the wamid now (inert) means 3b-2 only wires the ack endpoint — no data backfill.
aha_moments.aha_moment: 3b-2 ships in days, not weeks, because the correlation column is already populated for new sends.

aha_moments.user_pain: Dashboards that show 'sent' but never advance erode trust in the product.
aha_moments.suggestion: A populated wamid is the precondition for live status transitions on the Projeler/broadcast UI.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Users watch the read counter tick up in near real-time once 3b-2 lands on this foundation.

CQ1.evidence: Defensive ExtractWamid (null on non-string) + INV-SEED-058 fail-loud verifier.

CQ2.evidence: No new catch; null return is explicit, COALESCE avoids blanking.

CQ3.evidence: Files match plan scope; no allowlist/ack-endpoint/unrelated files.

CQ5.evidence: snake_case DDL; @eid parameterized; additive nullable DTO.

CQ6.evidence: Partial index (WHERE NOT NULL); no loops/N+1.

CQ8.evidence: Additive nullable property + optional param (named-arg caller); non-breaking.

CQ9.evidence: wamid only on Submitted; persistence tenant-scoped; tenant-composite unique.

Q1.reasoning: ValueKind String guard + whitespace check; tests cover string/null/empty/object.

Q2.reasoning: ProviderMessageId set only on Submitted; non-Submitted pass null; COALESCE no-op.

Q3.reasoning: Partial unique excludes NULL rows; IF NOT EXISTS idempotent; fails loud on real dups.

Q4.reasoning: No allowlist/ack-endpoint/lookup-scoping change; runtime no-op while gate closed.
